name: API Layer
description: Express server entry point and route handlers exposing REST endpoints for AI testing, deck management, and the core learning flow (session start, AI response, card review, next card).

name: Service Layer
description: Backend business logic including multi-model AI interaction (Qwen/Doubao/OpenAI), Anki-Connect proxying, in-memory session management, and frontend speech composables wrapping the Web Speech API.

name: UI Layer
description: Vue 3 frontend including the root App shell, router configuration, page-level views (DeckSelect, LearnView, SettingsView), the PhilosophyPanel presentational component, global stylesheet, and the HTML entry point.

name: Configuration
description: Project build and environment configuration including the npm package manifest, Vite build setup with API proxy, and environment variable template for Anki-Connect and server port.

name: Test Scripts
description: Standalone diagnostic and validation scripts for testing AI JSON response parsing and verifying Qwen multimodal API connectivity.

name: Documentation
description: Project documentation covering the product requirements document, English learning methodology research, common language-learning pitfalls, the input-output model for the four English skills, and the full implementation plan with architecture and roadmap.
